items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I thought I would learn something by working with him, so I went with him... He had a band in St. Paul... I left him to go with this Al Herbert

ctx.x: Who was this guy? He played trumpet. My memory fails me here. This guy had a little group that worked right up the street from us. I thought I would learn something by working with him, so I went with him, but I shouldn't have. I should have stayed where I was at in the first place. I was happy there and didn't realize it. L. Herbert, that's what his name was.
